Method of Attack: Steals account credentials and information from online banking sites via screenshots, form data theft, and keystroke logging
Impacted Systems: Banks in Australia, Europe, and United States
Attack Vector: Malspam emails pretending to be digital faxes from eFax with malicious Word documents
Indicators of Compromise: Affiliate id in C2 communication header; distribution via web injects, Fallout Exploit Kit, malspam campaigns, and Hancitor malware installation
